# Shenron - Dragon Ball Wiki & Public APIs

> Shenron is a comprehensive French database and interactive wiki dedicated to the Dragon Ball universe. It features details about characters, sagas, narrative arcs, anime episodes, movies, video games, manga chapters, techniques, and races. Shenron also includes public REST API endpoints and a grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant proxy.

This file provides LLM-friendly documentation for AI crawlers, code assistants, and search agents to understand and query the Shenron wiki database and API endpoints.

## Core Hubs & Navigation

- [Wiki Hub](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki): The main hub for the Dragon Ball archives.
- [Techniques Database](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/dragon-ball/techniques): Database of techniques, special abilities, and ki attacks.
- [Character Directory](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/personnages): Directory of characters and inhabitants across all twelve universes.
- [Planet Directory](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/personnages?tab=planetes): List of planets, including their status (intact or destroyed).
- [Saga Index](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/sagas): Interactive index of Dragon Ball sagas (from classic DB to Daima) and their narrative arcs.
- [Episode Guide](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/episodes): Guide for anime episodes from all series with images, titles, timecodes, and streams.
- [Movie Guide](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/films): Detailed movie list including posters, release dates, and trailers.
- [Video Game Guide](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/jeux): Directory of official Dragon Ball video games with platform listings.
- [Manga Index](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/manga): Index of manga volumes and chapters (DB, DBS).
- [Race Directory](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/races): Database of species/races in the Dragon Ball universe.
- [News Feed](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/wiki/news): Latest Dragon Ball news fetched from official feeds.
- [Discord Bot Slash Commands](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/commands): Guide to the Discord bot's slash commands.

## Public API Endpoints

- [Search API Endpoint](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/search): GET `/api/search?q={query}` - Cross-entity wiki search (returns character, planet, saga, movie, game, episode, technique matches). Optimized with pg_trgm for fault tolerance.
- [AI RAG Chat Endpoint](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/chat): GET `/api/chat?q={query}&persona={whis|goku|vegeta|bulma|freezer|roshi}&context={context}&session={session}&lang={lang}` - Proxy to the grounded RAG chat endpoint. Returns conversational AI answers utilizing the wiki database.

## Public Bot Data APIs

- [Characters API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/wiki/characters): GET `/api/public/wiki/characters` - Retrieve character list (supports search filter via `?q=`).
- [Character Detail API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/wiki/characters/:id): GET `/api/public/wiki/characters/:id` - Retrieve detailed information for a single character (including transformations and origin planet).
- [Planets API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/wiki/planets): GET `/api/public/wiki/planets` - Retrieve planet list.
- [Planet Detail API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/wiki/planets/:id): GET `/api/public/wiki/planets/:id` - Retrieve detailed information for a single planet.
- [Platform Stats API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/stats): GET `/api/public/stats` - Overall platform statistics (total users, XP, zeni, achievements unlocked, inventory count, shop items).
- [Personas API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/personas): GET `/api/public/personas` - List the 6 bot personas, their status, pings, and slash command usage statistics.
- [Slash Commands List API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/commands): GET `/api/public/commands` - Complete list of Discord slash commands categorized by bot persona.
- [Leaderboard API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/leaderboard): GET `/api/public/leaderboard?limit=100&enrich=1` - Retrieve top users by XP including Discord avatars and usernames.
- [Shop Items API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/shop): GET `/api/public/shop` - Complete catalog of shop items (cards, badges, colors, titles, banners).
- [User Profile API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/user/:discordId): GET `/api/public/user/:discordId` - Retrieve enriched user profile (XP, level, zeni, inventory, active banner, achievements).

## Optional

- [Profile Card Canvas API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/profile/:id/card.png): GET `/api/public/profile/:id/card.png?theme={theme}` - Generate profile card canvas (supports various color themes).
- [Scouter Canvas API](https://shenron.dragonballfr.com/api/public/profile/:id/scan.png): GET `/api/public/profile/:id/scan.png` - Generate scouter canvas image for a user's battle power scan.
